transport_design.decision: host networking, no port publishing, interactive TTY launch
transport_design.rationale: src/workspace/http.rs accepts only loopback peers, pins exact Host: 127.0.0.1:<internal-port>, rejects Forwarded/Via/X-Forwarded-* and enforces exact Origin. Bridge networking with -p fails the peer check (gateway source address) and the Host guard (port mismatch). Host networking preserves every guard unmodified.

failed_evidence_retained: First arm64 build attempt OOMed (cannot allocate memory) on the 2 GiB colima VM; resolved by Main resizing the VM to 6 CPUs / 8 GiB, not by changing the Dockerfile.
An intermediate build lost COPY schemas due to an editing mistake; rebuilt successfully after restoring it.

Bind-mounted private state root is ownership-squashed by colima virtiofs (uid 0 inside), failing workspace qualification; named volumes inherit image ownership (uid 10001, 0700) and pass. Compose uses a named volume for state.
Orphaned containers from killed docker clients hold the journal flock and block the next launch (single-owner design); smoke driver now removes containers explicitly.
limitations: Smoke evidence was produced on linux/arm64 natively; linux/amd64 was built and smoke-tested under QEMU emulation on this host (version, non-root identity, conversion).
Browser verification used installed Chrome headless via playwright; it is development evidence, not the maintained hosted-Chrome campaign or release acceptance.
No SBOM tool was available in this environment; image identity is bound via revision label, digest-pinned bases and Cargo.lock hash instead.
